mapper.select: /* selectMasterClMgCreditCmpyPop */ SELECT CMPY.COM_CODE , CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC , COD.ADD_DATE , COD.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID =COD.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME , SUBSTR(COD.TEXT3,0,3)||'-'||SUBSTR(COD.TEXT3,4,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(COD.TEXT3,6,5) IRS_NO , COD.TEXT4 AS REQ_DEPT_CD ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.TYPE = 'C001' AND COD2.COMPANY_CODE = COD.CODE1 AND COD2.CODE = COD.TEXT4) AS REQ_DEPT_NM , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(COD2.CODE),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD2 COD2 WHERE COD2.TYPE = 'BYEX' AND COD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD2.CODE = COD.CODE1) AS BYEX_YN FROM ICOMCOD3 COD , ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'BYMP' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' AND COD.TEXT1 = REPLACE(#{st_irs_no},'-','') AND COD.TEXT2 = #{st_dept_cd} AND COD.CODE1 = CMPY.COM_CODE ORDER BY CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC
